thread:
Maya: Heads-up — finance flagged a mismatch between the eu-west reserved commit for A10 pools and last month's invoice. Numbers don't line up with our committed GPU-hours. Anyone seen this?
Ken: Hmm, I noticed a small delta in us-west last week. How big is the gap?
Maya: Invoice shows 18,400 committed GPU-hours billed, but our active committed contracts sum to 16,000. ~+15% delta.
Priya: pinging billing-bot to pull the usage report + commit -> pool mapping.
billing-bot: [automated] Generated report: https://internal.reports/reports/1912345678-commit-usage.csv — billed_total=18400h; billed_tag=reserved-pool:eu-west1-dedicated-a10
Ryan: Can we confirm whether burst/overage auto-billing got applied? Also check for mis-tagged instances or stale standby nodes.
Ken: Quick scan of pool metadata shows two legacy pools without `reserved=true` but they were included in our old commit mapping script. Possible attribution leak.
Maya: Attaching screenshot of pool list and our current commit map (see below).
Maya: ```
# commit map snippet
commit_id: commit-eu-2025-a10
regions: [eu-west1]
pools: [pool-3245, pool-3302, pool-legacy-02]
# note: pool-legacy-02 was provisioned by a dev script in Jan
```
Ken: Run this to enumerate pools and tags: `rbctl pools list --region eu-west1 --json | jq '.[] | {id,name,tags,owner}'` — will help find untagged ones.
Priya: I'll run reconciliation between cloud-billing.csv and internal tags+commit map. ETA ~2h.
Ryan: Short-term mitigation: cap autoscaler on suspect pools and disable automatic creation from legacy scripts. Eg: `autoscaler:
  min_nodes: 0
  max_nodes: 2` for legacy pools to stop runaway hours.
Maya: Action items: Priya will reconcile and open a cloud billing case if needed; Ken will patch pool creation to require a `reserved_commit_id` tag in commit-enabled regions; Ryan will apply temporary autoscaler caps; I'll notify CS/finance about a possible credit.
Priya: Reconciled — found ~1,200h from two mis-tagged standby nodes (pool-legacy-02 & pool-legacy-03) and ~1,000h that appear as double-counted in our chargeback mapping. Total delta accounted: 2,200h.
Priya: Opened cloud billing ticket CB-9982. Provider acknowledged a double-counting issue for ~1,200h and proposed a credit. Remaining ~1,000h is internal: two test tenants were accidentally mapped to the commit in chargeback job.
Maya: Can you paste the ticket link and the exact line items we should expect to be credited?
Priya: Ticket: https://cloud.provider/tickets/CB-9982 — quoted items: resource_range [2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-28], resource_ids [vm-1245, vm-1299] flagged for double-charge = 1,200h. Internal mis-map: chargeback job produced duplicate mapping for commit-eu-2025-a10 -> will push a fix.
Ken: I'll add a validator in the pool creation API to require `reserved_commit_id` when `region` is in commit-enabled list and return 400 if missing. Draft PR: https://git.re/redwood/rbctl/pulls/2247
Ryan: I applied autoscaler caps to pool-legacy-02/03 and removed their active nodes. Monitoring shows no further consumption spikes.
Maya: Great. Priya, once the provider posts the credit, can you confirm and we can close finance loop? Also please include a short runbook to prevent recurrence.
Priya: Will add a runbook entry: steps to verify pool tags vs commit mapping, daily alert if billed_hours > committed_hours * 1.05 for any commit.
Maya: :thumbsup: scheduling a 10-min sync tomorrow to review fixes and confirm the credit. Closing this thread once ticket is resolved. Thanks everyone.
